normal.text: I would not have expected that a game with a box art like this would be the thing to spike my blood pressure... Koneko MonoGatari: The adventures of Chatran is a deceptively hard game, from cheap enemies to pixel perfect jumps. I shall endeavour as always, but if you want to make someone suffer you should challenge them to play this game. #RetroGaming #FamicomDiskSystem
